messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary "route-ttl-v2" id=deploy_6622223333 -> 10% traffic

sarah_support: Seeing a handful of customers reporting 503s since 09:12 UTC. examples from acme-inc and finco-org, errors on hosted inference endpoints.

maria_ops: I see a spike in 5xx on ingress-router, focused on tenant tags acme-inc. Logs show upstream reset + downstream error: "authorization header truncated" in a few traces.

kevin_runtime: That canary toggled a header forwarding limit. Guess: new config `route.header_forwarding.max_length=32` accidentally pushed. If auth header truncates, backend rejects -> 503 from our gateway.

sarah_support: Customer repro (from their ticket):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer longtoken-ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ1234567890" \ 
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
They get 503s intermittently.

maria_ops: grabbing request ids... found rids: rid=acme-20260318-09:12:11, acme-20260318-09:13:05. Backend logs show auth header length 28 then dropped entirely.

kevin_runtime: Confirmed in canary config: the route TTL patch also included an unsafe default for header length. Should be 4096. This looks like a bad canary config change. Recommend immediate rollback.

maria_ops: Agreed. Rolling back canary to stable now. Command: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --deploy-id deploy_6622223333`

maria_ops: Output: "rollback initiated, unpinning canary, shifting traffic to stable-20260317-4"

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: deploy_6622223333 -> rolled back at 09:18:42 UTC. Traffic restored to stable-20260317-4.

maria_ops: Monitoring metrics... 5xx for acme-inc dropping back to baseline within one minute. Confirming no other tenants affected.

sarah_support: Notified affected customers and opened credit requests where SLA thresholds hit. Customers acknowledged and asked for postmortem.

ashley_pm: Need quick postmortem and a release checklist update. Action items: 1) revert unsafe default in config; 2) add canary telemetry gate for auth failures; 3) ensure deploy pipeline flags non-zero header limits. @kevin_runtime can you own the fix & PR?

kevin_runtime: Yep. I'll open PR to set `route.header_forwarding.max_length=4096` and add unit test + canary alert (auth header truncation rate > 0.1% trigger). ETA EOD.

eric_oncall: Filed incident ticket INC-2026-172 to track customer impact, billing credits, and postmortem. Linking support tickets: SUP-8432, SUP-8441.

sarah_support: Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread open until PR merges and customers confirm stability.
